name: vault-circle-web
description: Vault Circle frontend — Lace wallet connect + observable-privacy demo for the Midnight ROSCA contract.

//tierC_writePathDeps._comment: Tier C (calling a circuit → generating a ZK proof → submitting) is GATED in this build: src/midnight/circuits.ts throws a clear WritePathUnavailableError instead of importing these. They are only needed once you deploy a contract, run the proof server (Docker), and want a real on-chain contribute(). Install them, then wire assembleWritePath() per the header in circuits.ts. Connect/disconnect, the privacy demo, and on-chain ledger reads all work WITHOUT them.
